specification.title: OGC 17-003r2 EO Dataset Metadata GeoJSON(-LD) Encoding Standard 1.0

inferredMediaTypes.description: Stated by OGC 17-003r2, chapter 9, Media Types for any data encoding(s): "When EO Dataset Metadata is delivered using HTTP, the following MIME media types shall be used." The table gives application/geo+json for the "GeoJSON representation with implicit normative context or normative context linked via a http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context HTTP Link Header"; its two other rows are the GeoJSON-LD representations (application/ld+json, with or without a profile parameter), which are not this format. Read on 2026-11-17. Not observed in an Implementation Profile or on the testbed: no role uses this format yet.

hasAction.description: Principal media type set (df:primaryMediaType): application/geo+json, the media type already recorded from the specification (df:inferredMediaType). OGC 17-003r2, chapter 9, says the listed media types shall be used when EO Dataset Metadata is delivered over HTTP, and gives application/geo+json for the GeoJSON representation, the encoding this format describes; its two application/ld+json rows are the GeoJSON-LD representations, which are not this format. application/geo+json is the media type RFC 7946 registers for GeoJSON. Checked on 2026-11-17 in https://docs.ogc.org/is/17-003r2/17-003r2.html. Decision of Gérald, 2026-11-17. The specification, the recorded media type and the JSON Schema fragment are unchanged. Classified substantive: the register specification lists the principal media type among the substantive changes.
